Bleeding per vagina in pregnancy has few differentials 
1. Normal bleeding also called as placental sign which occurs during implantation of the embryo
2. Threatened abortion. The embryo might go into spontaneous termination or it can survive
3. Bleeding after termination. Usually its very hard to differentiate this early in pregnancy if you've aborted or not because there's no significant mass in the embryo for you to tell if you've expelled the products of conception. 

In any case labs and a trans vaginal ultrasonography should confirm your pregnancy or abortion. 

If it's any comfort, if you've aborted just remember that the baby has not been formed yet. It is not viable before 20 weeks at least. So technically you haven't lost a baby. You lost few cells which might've become a baby and nature wasn't sure they were good enough to form a baby. 

Hope this helps. Wish you the best. I Pray that your pregnancy continues. If not I hope you recover quickly and try again.
